title: The Beauty Trap
era: Late Spring and Autumn · about 2,500 years ago

source.chapter: The Beauty Trap (the tale of Gou Jian presenting Xi Shi comes from the Wu Yue Chun Qiu, compiled long after the events and often questioned)
source.quote: Where the enemy's troops are strong, strike at their general; where their general is wise, work on his feelings. When the general is weak and the troops slack, their spirit wilts by itself. This is to use the enemy as a shield and keep both sides whole.

moral: Watch what the other person cares about, then give that one: right beats plenty.
transfer: See what a friend likes, then give that thing.
